prompt: Here's a PresenceService for the "who's online" feature of our realtime chat system. It tracks connected users in a single Redis bitmap and reports the live headcount with BITCOUNT — connect sets the user's bit, disconnect clears it. In production the "online:users" key has ballooned to hundreds of MB even though only a few thousand users are online at any moment. Walk me through why this bitmap is so large, and then optimize the presence store so memory scales with the number of online users rather than the magnitude of their ids — without changing what getOnlineCount() returns.
